Chapter 7017: Already Has An Owner

Chapter 7017: Already Has An Owner

The celestial source was priceless since it was Dusk’s accumulated essence.

Just a tiny bit of this source was extremely beneficial to any immortal. Robbing was the obvious choice, not leaving it to a so-called owner. They would be more than happy to eradicate Ye Fantian and her kingdom to obtain it.

“Hahaha, more pleasant to listen to than a song.” Ash-serpent said: “Monarch, since when does a primordial immortal such as yourself care about an insect? Aren’t you embarrassed to be spouting these words?”

“We admire your magnanimity.” Immortal Bronze moved as if it were bowing: “Unfortunately, you do not decide what happens here, and neither can I. Everyone risked their lives to get here, how will they leave empty-handed just based on your words? Even if I want to, they wouldn’t.”

“That’s right, everyone has a claim.” Autumn Wind said.

“You can’t force us to be unduly generous.” Other immortals chimed in.

The majority sided with Immortal Bronze and Ash-serpent.

“As you can see, this is beyond your control.” Ash-serpent laughed.

“And you are in control?” Heaven’s Equal sneered; his gaze alone intimidated weaker immortals.

“What do you think, Fellow Daoist?” He then asked Xiaolou Tingxue.

Others became tense, awaiting an answer. One side had two primordial immortals and a few golden immortals.

Heaven’s Equal alone was not enough. However, their chance of winning would be tiny if Xiaolou Tingxue were to join him.

“I am here for the celestial source.’ Xiaolou Tingxue responded: “However, I am willing to team up with you for it.”

He naturally wouldn’t give up the celestial source to an overlord and stated his stance.

“Fellow Daoist, this thing has a master already. To seize is will bring a calamity upon us. Please, join me.” Heaven’s Equal shook his head.

Xiaolou Tingxue stared at him while pondering. Heaven’s Equal was neither a fool nor a madman.

“For her? Even if we are generous enough to do so, it will only hasten her death. I’m afraid I can’t comply.” He refused the offer.

An overlord couldn’t defend herself against the immortals. Therefore, he might as well be the one to take the source.

“Yes, the celestial source can’t be in the possession of an ant, it will only harm her. Join us and you will have a fair share.” Immortal Bronze said.

“I have no interest in fighting alongside the likes of you.” Xiaolou Tingxue snorted, as if he would lose face by joining them.

Immortal Bronze and Ash-serpent found this humiliating since they were all celestial immortals.

“You don’t have to fight with us, just watch and you will still get a share. What do you think?” Immortal Bronze remained calm.

This condition was rather generous - to do nothing yet still get a share.

Ash-serpent scowled but didn’t interject.
